name: discord
description: Discord integration — send messages and rich embeds via an incoming webhook, or read channels and post anywhere a bot can reach using a bot token.
author: Buildersoft LLC

integration.description: Send messages and embeds via webhook, or read/post via a bot token

fields.label: Webhook URL
fields.helpText: For sending messages to one channel (no bot needed)

fields.label: Bot Token
fields.helpText: For reading channels / sending to any channel the bot can access

tools.name: discord.send_message
tools.description: Send a text message. Uses a webhook URL (per-message or configured) if given, otherwise a bot token posting to a channel.

webhookUrl.description: Override the configured webhook URL for this message

channelId.description: Channel id to post to when using a bot token

tools.name: discord.send_embed
tools.description: Send a rich embed (title, description, color, link). Uses a webhook URL if given, otherwise a bot token posting to a channel.

webhookUrl.description: Override the configured webhook URL for this embed

channelId.description: Channel id to post to when using a bot token

color.description: Sidebar color as a decimal integer (e.g. 5814783)

url.description: URL the embed title links to

tools.name: discord.list_messages
tools.description: List recent messages in a channel. Requires a bot token.

channelId.description: Channel id to read messages from

tools.name: discord.get_channel
tools.description: Get metadata for a channel. Requires a bot token.
